'''Takaaki Uchino''' (Japanese: '''内野孝聡''' ''Uchino Takaaki'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Uchino was born sometime on April 10 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He became a voice actor as an adult and mostly got minor roles. He joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, voicing [[Team Skull]] member [[Tupp]] for two episodes before being replaced by [[Toru Sakurai]]. Uchino is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|81 Produce}}.
